## Overview

A pale blue crystal, fist-sized. A solid manifestation of the Air Elemental's destroyed essence -- not a fragment of B's residual energy (like arcane-reactive crystals), but a pure concentration of elemental power. First of four elemental soul crystals Nyra must collect.

---

## Description

Pale blue, almost translucent, with faint white currents swirling within like captured wind. No light of its own, but refracts ambient light into prismatic patterns. Cool to the touch. Faint hum when held.

---

## Properties

| Property | Detail |
|----------|--------|
| Type | Elemental essence manifestation |
| Origin | Destroyed Air Elemental in the Cavern of Discovery |
| Appearance | Pale blue crystal with internal white swirling currents |
| Sensation | Cool; faint hum; slight breeze sensation nearby |
| Function | Required to unlock smaller mystery box (when combined with three other soul crystals) |
| Secondary Effect | Slightly amplifies Nyra's air genasi abilities when tied to her staff |

---

## Current Location

Tied to the top of Nyra's quarterstaff with leather cord. Carried at all times.
